lines.en: This meadow is my territory.
I step and pause, watching the border.
The wind up here is colder than below.
The leader walks in the middle.
We move along the mountain ridge.
I push the tall grass aside with my knuckles.
If I go far, I must patrol back.

lines.zh: 石头上还留着我的脚印。
lines.en: My footprints are still on the stone.
Do not step on the young one's tail.
The meadow ends at the cliff edge.
I walk sideways through the narrow path.
Has someone fallen behind the group?
I chew a grass stalk as I walk.

lines.zh: 这里的每块石头我都认得。
lines.en: I know every stone in this meadow.

lines.zh: 我蹲坐下来，用两只手走路。
lines.en: I squat and walk on two hands.
The leader halts and the whole troop halts.

lines.zh: 高海拔的草甸，我坐在崖边。
lines.en: On the high meadow I sit at the cliff edge.
I think I’ve already grazed this clump.
Easy — don’t trample this grassy slope.

lines.zh: 高海拔的草甸，风很干净。
lines.en: The highland meadow air is clean.
A flick of my lion tail — downhill we go.

lines.zh: 跟紧我狮尾，别在草甸走散。
lines.en: Stay with my lion tail, don’t get lost in the meadow.

lines.zh: 我从这块岩跳去那块岩。
lines.en: I leap from this rock to that one.

lines.zh: 高海拔的草甸，风比草多。
lines.en: On the high meadow, more wind than grass.

lines.zh: 我坐在崖边，胸口的红斑露出来。
lines.en: On the cliff edge my red chest patch shows.

lines.zh: 高处的草甸，就是我家的坡。
lines.en: These high meadows are my home slope.
I climb faster today than yesterday.

lines.zh: 高地的风把我毛吹成一团。
lines.en: Highland wind knots my fur into clumps.
Highland wind combs my fur.

lines.zh: 高草甸的草籽，我一颗颗捡。
lines.en: On the high meadow I pick seeds one by one.

lines.zh: 高地的暗流，走起来真别扭。
lines.en: These highland undercurrents make walking awkward.
I’ll rest once we cross this ridge.

lines.zh: 我坐着，看云从山那边来。
lines.en: I sit and watch clouds come over the mountain.
With idle hands, I want to groom someone.

lines.zh: 我翻开同伴的毛找东西。
lines.en: I part my herdmate's fur, searching.
The sun warms my back.
The sound of chewing grass is monotonous.
I rest my chin on my knees.
An eagle circles in the distance.
I count how many are in the troop.
The grass here has been grazed short.
The leader yawns and shows his teeth.
I pat my chest; it is a habit.
The wind stops, and the grass is still.
I want to sleep, but someone must watch.

lines.zh: 这块石头坐起来正合适。
lines.en: This stone is just right for sitting.

lines.zh: 我胸前这块红，是草甸的印记。
lines.en: The red on my chest marks the meadow.
The slope is warm — I’ll doze a moment.
Mist beads on the grass tips — so cool.

lines.zh: 草甸的风把毛吹成一片。
lines.en: The meadow wind flattens my fur.
A cloud shadow passes; the slope cools.

lines.zh: 我胸口那块红斑，是天生的。
lines.en: The red patch on my chest is natural.
Highland grass, short and just right.
I have flattened the highland grass with sitting.

lines.zh: 这块崖石晒得暖，坐着正好。
lines.en: This cliff rock is warm — perfect to sit on.
Sat too long; my legs have gone numb.

lines.zh: 我在等草籽自己掉下来。
lines.en: I’m waiting for the seeds to fall on their own.
I count how many clumps I’ve grazed.
Which clump should I graze today?

lines.zh: 我翻起上唇，露出这口巨齿。
lines.en: I flip my lip and show these big teeth.
You are standing on my border.
Your boots are crushing the grass.
Do not imitate my call; you sound wrong.
Humans rarely climb this high.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛在打什么主意？
lines.en: What is going on behind your eyes?
I watch you; you move first.

lines.zh: 我看看你的手有没有东西。
lines.en: I check whether your hands hold anything.

lines.zh: 你靠近一步，我就站起来。
lines.en: One step closer and I stand up.

lines.zh: 这张脸，我在山道上见过。
lines.en: I have seen that face on the mountain path.

lines.zh: 我们互相看着，谁都不让。
lines.en: We stare at each other, neither yielding.
Which mountain did you cross from?
You graze on the meadow too?

lines.zh: 你手里没草，是来抓我的？
lines.en: No grass in your hands — are you here to catch me?

lines.zh: 草甸上，我们一家坐成一排。
lines.en: On the meadow we sit in a row.

lines.zh: 你身上有铁锈和皮革味。
lines.en: You smell of rust and leather.
Both eyes in front — strange.
Gelada Monkey? I'll remember that.
You stand taller than the bent tree on the cliff.

lines.zh: 我在高原草甸上啃草根。
lines.en: I graze roots on the highland meadow.

lines.zh: 我该逃上崖，还是盯着你？
lines.en: Should I flee up the cliff, or keep watching?

lines.zh: 肩膀挨了一下，牙还完好。
lines.en: My shoulder took it; my teeth are fine.
I am bleeding; I retreat behind the rock.
It hurts, but I will not run first.

lines.zh: 你站在哪块石头上，我清楚。
lines.en: I know which stone you stand on.

lines.zh: 草甸的石头比你的手硬。
lines.en: The meadow stones are harder than your hands.
Stop; I will accept the boundary.
I curl up and guard my chest.
My cry echoes off the rock walls.
I retreated three steps, still standing.

lines.zh: 你出手比岩石滚落还快。
lines.en: You strike faster than falling rock.

lines.zh: 我胸口这道红，是天生的。
lines.en: This red patch on my chest was always there.

lines.zh: 轻点，我胸口这块皮很薄。
lines.en: Easy — the skin on my chest is thin.
I hadn’t even crouched steady.

lines.zh: 我的鬃毛一抖，整群都叫。
lines.en: One shake of my mane and the troop calls.

lines.zh: 水里怎么有铁味，草甸不该有。
lines.en: Why does the water smell of iron? Not on a meadow.

lines.zh: 你打到了我胸口那块红斑。
lines.en: You struck my red chest patch.
The fangs are still here, so keep back.

lines.zh: 我抓起一把草根，捏碎了。
lines.en: I grab a handful of grass roots and crush them.
Who threw that stone? Step out.

lines.zh: 我这一身毛，不擅长下水。
lines.en: All this fur is no good in water.
That is wheat in your hand, right?
A handful of wheat for a patch of grass.
Feed me, and I will pull your weeds.
I smell the dry husks of wheat.
The leader has not nodded; I just watch.
I eat grass, but wheat I love more.
Step back and put the wheat down.
This mouthful is worth leaving the meadow.

lines.zh: 我只要麦子，不要你的手。
lines.en: I want the wheat, not your hand.
After this patch, do you have more?

lines.zh: 我翻了两道坡才找到这丛草。
lines.en: I crossed two slopes to find this clump.

lines.zh: 这嫩茎比干草好吃多了。
lines.en: These tender stems beat dry grass.
I squat down for grass stems, not fish.
That bundle of grass — spare me a little.
Who scattered so many grass seeds?
Highland grass. I do want it.
Just a lick of dew, I won’t be greedy.
Highland grass smells so sweet.
This root smells sweet.
The roots smell sweet, but you stand too close.
You have stumbled into my territory.
Shoulder to shoulder, and I do not yield.
Steady; do not push me down the slope.
My fur is now on your clothes.
Push again and my lip curls back.
I step back because I cannot be bothered.
You stepped on the stone I was sitting on.
The whole troop is watching us.
Do not push with hands; use words.
I step aside; you step aside too.

lines.zh: 你走你的路，我啃我的草。
lines.en: You walk your path; I graze mine.

lines.zh: 你比礁石还硬，撞得我头昏。
lines.en: Harder than reef rock; my head is ringing.
My mane is all mussed.
My mane is wider than you are.

lines.zh: 高海拔的草，我蹲着慢慢嚼。
lines.en: Highland grass, chewed crouching.

lines.zh: 你们这些块头大的，挤得慌。
lines.en: You big ones crowd me.

lines.zh: 你撞过来，像滚石一样沉。
lines.en: You hit like a rolling boulder.

lines.zh: 撞得我胸口的红斑都疼。
lines.en: That knocked my red chest patch sore.
Who’s blundering across the meadow?

lines.zh: 我这一身鬃毛，够挡住半个山口。
lines.en: My mane alone blocks half the pass.
Before breeding, I must see dry brush.
When she grooms me, I understand.

lines.zh: 首领在看着，我不能乱来。
lines.en: The leader watches; I must behave.

lines.zh: 这是我一生的事，别围观。
lines.en: This matters to me; do not crowd us.

lines.zh: 我们坐在草甸最安静处。
lines.en: We sit where the meadow is quietest.

lines.zh: 幼崽会抓着我的毛长大。
lines.en: The young will grow up gripping my fur.
The dry branches are placed; that is enough.

lines.zh: 我把胸口挺起来给她看。
lines.en: I raise my chest for her to see.

lines.zh: 我们这一群，还要多一口。
lines.en: Our troop will need one more mouth.
Do not laugh; this ritual is serious.

lines.zh: 你愿意跟着我上草甸吗？
lines.en: Will you follow me up to the meadow?
That tuft on your tail is lovely.
This mountain wind bears witness for us.

lines.zh: 高海拔的草，我一片片吃。
lines.en: I graze the high meadow blade by blade.
The high meadow is my home.

lines.zh: 狮尾一甩，草籽全落在窝边。
lines.en: My lion tail flicks seeds by the nest.

lines.zh: 这一圈，是绕着草甸走的。
lines.en: This lap I walk around the meadow.
Let’s finish grazing this patch first.
We’ll sit on the cliff until dawn.

lines.zh: 高地的草甸上，我只要一个伴。
lines.en: On the high meadow, I want only one companion.
I pick up a dry twig.
I sniffed this little thing.

lines.zh: 手里的草，我留着慢慢吃。
lines.en: I keep this grass to eat later.
A fallen fruit? I leave it alone.
I tuck it into a crack in the rock.
This is not grass; I do not want it.
I grab it, then toss it away.

lines.zh: 你的东西落在我脚边了。
lines.en: Your thing fell beside my feet.
I hold it in both hands like a stone.
Can this thing be traded for wheat?
What’s this doing on the meadow?
This hard nut — I’ll keep it to grind my teeth.

lines.zh: 这块根茎压在石头底下。
lines.en: This root was pinned under a stone.

lines.zh: 这颗草籽是我先刨出来的。
lines.en: I dug up this grass seed first.
This fruit sits heavy in my mouth.

lines.zh: 这玩意儿是从木箱里滚出来的。
lines.en: This thing rolled out of a crate.

lines.zh: 高海拔的草甸，我挖得很熟。
lines.en: I know these highland meadows well.
A fruit drifted down the water.

lines.zh: 草根也能换一顿，我拿着。
lines.en: Even roots trade for a meal; I keep them.

lines.zh: 高地的草根，我掏出来了。
lines.en: I dug out the highland grass roots.
Whoever crosses gets my lip curled back.

lines.zh: 我站起来，比坐着高多了。
lines.en: On my feet, I am much taller.
No one takes this patch of grass.
I open my mouth and show those teeth.
The troop turned; you are in trouble.
The target is just past the fence.

lines.zh: 我把胸口挺出来给你看。
lines.en: I thrust my scarlet chest at you.
Back off, and I will forget it.
My call will bring the others.
One wrong step and do not blame me.
The horned one — hit it first.
You up the slope — stay still.
It shifts a step; I follow.

lines.zh: 今天终于有东西送上门。
lines.en: Something finally comes to me today.
All this highland grass belongs to my troop.
The waves of grass hide my body.
The high meadow is mine.
I bear a red patch on my chest.

lines.zh: 你跑不过我这两条后腿。
lines.en: You can’t outrun these hind legs.
That shape below the slope is moving.
I follow you along the rock wall.

lines.zh: 你跑得再快，也上不了坡。
lines.en: Run fast; you still cannot climb this slope.
I take it one step at a time.
Look back, and I am right there.
My hands can grip the cracks in the rock.

lines.zh: 这叫声是给全群的信号。
lines.en: This call is a signal for the troop.

lines.zh: 你踩碎的草暴露了位置。
lines.en: The grass you crushed gives you away.
Do not head toward the cliff.
I am blocking the way down.

lines.zh: 你和我之间只差三块石头。
lines.en: Only three stones separate you and me.

lines.zh: 草甸上没有能藏人的沟。
lines.en: No ditch on this meadow to hide in.
Climbing this slope, you pant faster than I do.

lines.zh: 高海拔的草甸，我坐得稳。
lines.en: On the high meadow, I sit steady.

lines.zh: 风把你身上的味送过来了。
lines.en: The wind carries your scent to me.
I know this meadow better than you.

lines.zh: 草甸上没有水，你逃不掉。
lines.en: There’s no water here to escape into.

lines.zh: 再迈一步，我的獠牙就够到。
lines.en: One more step and my fangs reach you.

lines.zh: 高山草甸上，我追你比追鱼快。
lines.en: On the high meadow I chase you faster than fish.
My tail swings like a lion's.
The slope is short; you won’t get far.
My teeth are longer than they look.
This swipe is for trespassers.
I shove you down the slope.
My arm swings heavy.
I am not cruel; I am guarding home.
After this swipe, I withdraw.
You will keep a mark on your arm.
The whole troop is behind me.
I strike shoulders, not throats.
One more step and the teeth come out.

lines.zh: 我的獠牙，尝到苦头了吗？
lines.en: My fangs — did you taste them?
Back down the slope — don’t push me.

lines.zh: 你腿长，可我一步能跨半坡。
lines.en: Long legs — but I clear half a slope per leap.
I’ll shoulder you down the slope.
One sweep of my lion tail and you’re over.

lines.zh: 我甩一甩狮尾，整片草甸都听见。
lines.en: One swing of my lion tail and the whole meadow hears.
I’ll send you tumbling to the slope’s foot.
Head down — charge with my fangs!
Get off my grassy slope.

lines.zh: 我胸口这块红斑，是给同伴看的。
lines.en: This red patch is for my troop.

lines.zh: 我出生在雪线附近的草甸。
lines.en: I was born on a meadow near the snowline.
My first mouthful was green grass.

lines.zh: 父亲有一圈浓密的鬃毛。
lines.en: My father had a thick mane.

lines.zh: 我抓着母亲的毛上了山。
lines.en: I rode my mother's fur up the mountain.
The air is thin at this height.

lines.zh: 我看见的第一样东西是岩石。
lines.en: The first thing I saw was rock.
The troop has one more mouth.
I am learning to turn grass for roots.
The cold wind makes me curl up.

lines.zh: 从今天起，这里也是我的。
lines.en: From today, this place is mine too.
I just opened my eyes in a grass nest.

lines.zh: 山脊那边有石头滚下来了。
lines.en: Stones are rolling down beyond the ridge.
The meadow is too still; even the wind stopped.
Mountain wind pushes me along.

lines.zh: 后腿还没醒，先站一会儿。
lines.en: My hind legs haven’t woken; let me stand a while.
First, find a cliff rock to sit on.
The mountain wind is cold — just right.
Let’s begin, this slope of grass.

lines.zh: 周围的草一动，我就听见。
lines.en: Any stir in the grass, I hear it.
Do not eat me; I am not grown yet.
The fire seared my fingers.

lines.zh: 我这一身毛，被火燎卷了。
lines.en: The fire curled my coat.
I slid down off the stone.
I slid off the cliff — my rump hurts.
The meadow stream is deeper than it looks.
The mist is too thick — I can’t breathe.

lines.zh: 这响声让整片草甸发颤。
lines.en: That roar made the whole meadow shake.

lines.zh: 我的长毛被炸得竖起来。
lines.en: The blast left my long fur standing.
An arrow stuck in my fur.

lines.zh: 水里怎么也有箭飞过来。
lines.en: Arrows flying in the water too?

lines.zh: 紫色的光让我头皮发麻。
lines.en: The purple light numbs my scalp.
A purple light rises from the grass.
Snow covers the grass; I am hungry.
I can’t even chew juice from roots now.
Lightning splits a pine on the ridge.

lines.zh: 天上打的雷，水里也跟着疼。
lines.en: Thunder up there, pain down here in the water.
The mountain is gone; only black remains.
My lion tail just hangs here.
